entries.41f545067c4cebb0: A division that handles the construction of facilities for broadcasting and telecommunications operators in a consistent manner, from business planning and system analysis to network design, equipment selection, installation, and system operation and maintenance. It provides digital broadcasting solutions compatible with 4K8K broadcasting, high-speed data communication solutions, announcement broadcasting systems for regional disaster prevention, optical fiber network construction and more. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥5,473 million.
entries.4469298ad22f56a4: This division selects optimal equipment for systems and sells it to cable television operators, telecommunications carriers and ISPs. It handles equipment developed and manufactured in-house as well as products of other companies, including overseas products, and after thorough verification of specifications and compatibility with systems, it also performs customization incorporating proprietary technology developed in-house as needed. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,014 million.
entries.6509f086d2a1e4c7: A system integration company for cable television operators, handling everything from the design and construction of broadcasting and communication systems to equipment sales, operation, and maintenance.
entries.87821e1ffc76f177: This is the single segment of the group. It is a system integration business that provides system design, equipment selection, installation, and maintenance and management to broadcasting and communications operators, including cable television operators. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥10,488 million.
